name: hybrid_lqr_control
hypothesis: Hybrid LQR steering correction layered on pure pursuit, with conservative gains bounded to 0.02 rad, improves average and median lap time without raising tracking error.
prediction: mean better than T03's 9.589 with no contacts over 25-40 laps
verdict_short: CONTROL for the a_long ladder: 38 clean laps, 0 contacts, mean 9.594 -- lap-time NEUTRAL vs T03
verdict: Hybrid LQR at these gains is lap-time NEUTRAL. 38 clean laps, zero contacts, mean 9.594 against T03's pure-pursuit 9.589 -- identical within noise. It takes the best lap (9.450 vs 9.496) and doubles the clean-lap count, so it is kept for reliability, but steering is at a plateau and the remaining time is not there. The reset cascade at the end of this run was a MANUAL simulator reset, not a crash. This run is the control against which the a_long ladder (S01-S03) is measured.
